text:
- chief complaint: right upper arm pain after a fall while playing volleyball, rated 9/10 and not relieved by ibuprofen.
- history of present illness: the patient fell onto the right arm/shoulder after being tripped mid-spike about 18 hours before the visit. X-ray shows a proximal humerus fracture. Ibuprofen every six hours has not helped. No ice applied. Pain is severe.
- physical examination: right shoulder swelling, erythema, and tenderness. Pulses normal, rest of the exam normal. Able to straighten the elbow without moving the shoulder.
- symptoms experienced by the patient: severe right upper arm/shoulder pain (9/10). No numbness or tingling in the right arm.
- new medications prescribed or changed: Lortab 5 mg, one to two tablets every six hours as needed for pain, #20.
- follow-up instructions: long arm cast and sling; return in two weeks to check bone alignment. If misaligned, surgery will be discussed at that time.
